descriptions.teams_list: List all teams in the Catapult OpenField account (GET /teams). No parameters. Returns an array of {id, name}. Call this first when a workflow needs a team id to scope athletes, activities, or load reports — team names are not accepted as filters elsewhere, ids are.
descriptions.venues_list: List all venues configured in the Catapult OpenField account (GET /venues). No parameters. Returns an array of {id, name}. Use this to discover venue ids; when you already have a venue_id, prefer venues_get to fetch just that venue.
descriptions.customer_get: Fetch the authenticated Catapult OpenField account profile (GET /customer/info). No parameters. Returns the customer id and account name. Use it to confirm which OpenField tenant the API token belongs to before syncing data or running stats queries; for unit preferences use customer_settings instead.
